manifest.population: 24 complete type-live degree-comparative pairs, balanced eight each across rival-doer, rival-done-to, and adjunct-rival completions
manifest.selection: All pairs were authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure. Each comparator removes only the role-completing words, returning the bare rival form whose per-use token cost the proposal bounds. The role-completed sentence preserves the intended ordering claim and uses ordinary English do-support, repeated predicates, or kept prepositions.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)). Average equally within each eight-item completion stratum and equally across the three strata. The headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. File all finite outcomes once without tuning.

estimand.aggregation: equal completion-stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the same clause ending in the bare rival with role-completing words removed

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes any counts.

commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

replication.comparator: the same clause ending in the bare rival with role-completing words removed
replication.population: fresh type-live degree comparatives sampled across rival-doer, rival-done-to and adjunct-rival completions
replication.aggregation: equal item mean within each completion stratum, equal weight across the three strata, then maximum tokenizer mean

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
